def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, Solver, And, sat

    # Base script variables and constraints
    folio_test_slab = Int('folio_test_slab')
    object = Int('object')

    s = Solver()
    s.add(folio_test_slab == 0)
    s.add(object == 0)

    # Constraint set 1 variables and constraints
    ptr = Int('ptr')
    zero_or_null_ptr = Int('zero_or_null_ptr')
    kfree_early_return = Int('kfree_early_return')
    folio_test_slab_evaluated = Int('folio_test_slab_evaluated')

    s.add(ptr == 0)
    s.add(zero_or_null_ptr == 1)
    s.add(kfree_early_return == 1)
    s.add(folio_test_slab_evaluated == 0)

    # Constraint set 2 constraints (object already declared above)
    PAGE_SIZE = 4096
    s.add(object != 0)
    s.add(object >= PAGE_SIZE)

    result = s.check()
    return result == sat
